name: pSy†darlINg DEBUT! Dai Ichi Dan ~Gouyoku no Long Island Ice Tea~
original_name: pSy†darlINg DEBUT！第一弾 ～強欲のロングアイランドアイスティー～
source:
The protagonist, a former idol producer, is depressed by a big mistake he made his previous workplace. He resigned and ends up staying home. However, one day, a sharp needle suddenly pierced through the days he spent drowning in his own regrets!

He was forced to make a contract with the president of a new entertainment agency who calls himself a "great devil", and he was forced to work as a producer of the seven-member idol unit "pSy † darlINg", which is inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

It's a pity that the producer was forced to take part in the devil's plan for no apparent reason, but he managed to run the office because of his passion for idols. Plan to "experience each solo work" to grow his own idol unit.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5440]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本是一名偶像制作人，却因在上一份工作中犯下重大错误而意志消沉，辞职后整天闭门不出。然而某天，一根锐利的针，突然刺破了这段沉溺于悔恨的日子！

一家新成立的艺人事务所社长自称“大恶魔”，强迫他签下契约，让他担任七人偶像组合“pSy†darlINg”的制作人。这个组合以七宗罪为主题。

可怜的制作人莫名其妙地被卷入恶魔的计划，却还是凭着对偶像的热情，勉强维持着事务所的运作。为了让自己负责的组合成长，他计划让成员们“各自体验单独接工作的经历”。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5440]NovelGame[/url]]
